page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top centre, page number at top left. No marginal notes. A stray dot stands in the left margin beside the line "no & equa genitus". The text ends with "fimiles:" at the foot of the column.

main_text.p: pè verbis in Lælio. Quòd si hoc (inquit) ap-paret in beftiis, vt requirant atque appetant ad quas fe applicét,eiufdem generis animan-tes,quanto magis in homine fit natura, vt al-terum acquirat, cuius animum ita cum fuo commifceat,vt efficiat penè vnum ex duobus?

Quid? Regula illa peruulgata, vtro ex loco fumpta eft? Non debet cui plus licet, quod minus eft non litere. Ex comparatione mi-noris. Minus enim dicitur, quod minus con-uenire & licere poffe videbatur.At illud, Qui fidem in re parua non præftitit,is in magna nó præftabit : ex maioris comparatione fum-ptum eft: id eft eius quod magis conuenire videbatur.
main_text.head: De loco Diffimilium. CAP. XXXII.
main_text.p: VOD[?] eft firmamentum de Difsi-milibus? Vt rerum difparitas, fic etiam difsimilitudo ex tertio aliquo exquiritur. Itaque primum firmamentum eft huiufmodi. I: Quæ in tertio aliquo difsimilia funt, quorúmque item alterum duntaxat fimile eft, etiam inter fe difsi-milia funt. Itaque locus hic ad probandam difsimilitudinem valet. veluti cùm quæritur, An afinus & mulus difsimiles fint: fic concludetur:Si afinus ex afino & afina, mulus ex afi-no & equa genitus eft, funt difsimiles . Itémque fi quæratur,An mulus & hinnulus fint dif-similes:

page.notes: The large decorated initial of the first word of the last paragraph is hard to read; it reads as V or Q followed by "OD", so the word is marked [?]. The stray dot in the left margin beside "no & equa" appears to be a printed mark, not a note; it is not transcribed as text. The word "dif" at the end of the last line is followed by "fimiles:" on the next line with no printed hyphen, so it is written whole as "difsimiles:" (the line-end and next-line words run on). The "nó" in "in magna nó præftabit" is printed with an abbreviation mark, copied as printed.
